correctness.rationale: Complete maximal-geodesic classification yields exact simplicial complex decomposition. A connected join of discrete petal complexes has integral homotopy a sphere wedge; coning the N discrete attachment points adds N-1 independent one-cells. Facet enumeration gives both polynomial formulas and purity, all quantifiers and singleton boundaries included. Standalone script checks 102 small profiles by independently enumerating shortest paths and mod-two boundary ranks.

value.rationale: The formula determines integral homotopy and all reduced homology ranks for a natural infinite graph family; three or more nontrivial clique petals give both one-dimensional and higher-dimensional homology simultaneously. Existing scalar covering numbers do not capture this mixed-dimensional effect. Exact enumerators and purity boundary provide structural supporting information rather than an isolated arbitrary numerical slice.
